name: Brutal Helm
summary: In Thunder Bluff, Orm Stonehoof brings the warrior’s trial to its end with Brutal Helm. After gathering rare beast trophies across Kalimdor, an aspiring warrior earns recognition with a horned helm that honors their strength.

sections.title: A Warrior's Rite
sections.body: Orm Stonehoof is a stern smith in Thunder Bluff who guides Horde warriors through hard rites of passage. The trials test their skill in battle. Initiates hunt dangerous creatures in treacherous lands and claim rare trophies. Only those who meet Orm’s high standards may come before him to complete their armor.

sections.title: The Gift of the Earthmother
sections.body: The warrior proves their resolve in the wild by bringing Orm Stonehoof a rare chimaeric horn. In return, Orm presents Brutal Helm, heavy mail crafted to honor the beast and strengthen its wearer in the front line. As he gives the helm, Orm calls on the Earthmother’s blessing. He looks to the greater deeds the warrior is bound to undertake across Azeroth.

faq.answer: Orm Stonehoof, a tauren blacksmith in Thunder Bluff, presents Brutal Helm to Horde warriors who complete his trials.

faq.q: What task must be finished before receiving the helm?
faq.answer: Before receiving the helm, you complete the trial named Chimaeric Horn. You hunt fierce beasts in the wilderness and bring their horn to Orm Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.
Orm Stonehoof is near the pool beside the great central totem in Thunder Bluff’s high mesa city.

faq.q: Why does Orm Stonehoof invoke the Earthmother?
faq.answer: As a tauren, Orm honors the Earthmother as the world’s creator and spiritual guardian. Her blessing on a warrior’s finished helm reflects the tauren belief that battle strength must be balanced with spiritual reverence.

faq.q: Is this trial open to any adventurer?
faq.answer: No. The trial and its Brutal Armor rewards are for Horde warriors who prove their mettle through dedicated class trials.

faq.q: What is the significance of the Brutal Armor set?
aliases: why is it called brutal helm
faq.answer: The Brutal Armor pieces mark a warrior’s progress from novice soldier to elite champion of the Horde. They are made from materials gathered from Kalimdor’s fiercest predators.

angles.text: As a Horde warrior, you pass a key rite and take up heavy armor forged from ferocious beasts and blessed by veteran trainers.
In Thunder Bluff, your helm reflects the tauren tradition of turning hunting trophies into protective wargear under the Earthmother’s grace.
Beneath the Horde banner, you prove the physical endurance and hunting skill your leaders demand.
